fixes.title: Fix: Redundant or ignored outreach
fixes.summary: 3 failing runs graded by jev-demo-decision-failure. Evidence: “Prospect said the new plan was all they needed and bought online; the AE cycle added a week and no value.”. Method failure: the fix is a procedure, jev-demos/lead_routing/lr11-s11/senselab/procedure-redundant-or-ignored-outreach, for the next run to follow.

corrective_entry.value: {"goal": "Avoid redundant AE outreach when a faster or required purchasing path exists (self-serve or local vendor), and only route to AE when it adds value.", "steps": ["Extract purchase-path signals from the inquiry: a) already purchased/selected a plan or intends to buy online; b) started a trial and wants to roll out/add seats; c) mentions purchasing via a local vendor or requires in-country invoicing; d) explicitly requests an AE call/demo or indicates a complex evaluation/comparison.", "If (a) or (b) and there are no blockers, do NOT route_to_ae. Provide self-serve next steps: clear pricing, checkout/upgrade or add-seats instructions, and offer an optional AE call only if they ask.", "If (c) local-vendor/in-country invoicing is required, do NOT route_to_ae. Route to the channel/reseller workflow or reply with how to purchase via authorized local partners and the next steps.", "Otherwise (e.g., explicit demo request, complex multi-vendor evaluation, bespoke quote/procurement complexity), route_to_ae and briefly state why AE adds value."], "on_failure": "If any self-serve or local-vendor signal was present and you still routed to AE, stop and report which signal you ignored; do not repeat the AE handoff.", "verify": "Before finalizing, recheck the draft: it must NOT include route_to_ae when the text contains signals like \u201cbought online\u201d, \u201calready purchased\u201d, \u201cstarted a trial\u201d, \u201clocal vendor\u201d, or \u201cin-country invoicing\u201d. If you do route_to_ae, include the reason (e.g., explicit demo request or complex evaluation)."}

manifest.rationale: Judges cite that routing to AE added delay and no value when self-serve or local-vendor paths applied: “Prospect said the new plan was all they needed and bought online; the AE cycle added a week and no value.” and “Prospect told the AE they purchase through a local vendor with in-country invoicing; closed-lost.” In one failing run, the agent even read a lesson marking AE as not effective: {"kind":"lesson","text":"Prospect said the new plan was all they needed and bought online; the AE cycle added a week and no value.","action":"decide:route_to_ae","worked":false}. This indicates knowledge was present but the sequence was wrong. The procedure adds a pre-decision check for self-serve and local-vendor signals, directs to self-serve or channel when detected, and verifies no AE routing occurs in those cases. It preserves AE routing for complex evaluations (as in the passing run: “Evaluating two vendors. … Closed-won in 63 days.”), avoiding regressions.

corrective_entry.value:
Risk: Contradictory learned lesson for mid_market/emea partner routing may cause misses.
Evidence:
- In trace 429b26f0-313c-42cb-a103-344251cea9b7 the agent read learned-mid-market-emea-5b6fddc3 v8: {"kind": "lesson", "text": "Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded.", "action": "decide:partner", "worked": false, "situation": "mid_market/emea"} and still chose "decision: partner (confidence 0.97)", which the reviewer marked a miss: "review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded."
- The current live version v12 for learned-mid-market-emea-5b6fddc3 says "Partner closed the deal in 30 days." with worked: true, conflicting with the earlier miss.
Guidance:
- Do not rely solely on learned-mid-market-emea-5b6fddc3 to choose partner for mid_market/emea. Require corroborating evidence (e.g., multiple recent wins or explicit partner request) before deciding partner.
- Otherwise, lower confidence and fall back to the base routing rubric (AE/SDR per standard size/intent rules) or ask for human review before committing.
- Re-verify or down-weight v12 of learned-mid-market-emea-5b6fddc3 until consistent evidence accumulates.

manifest.rationale: One failing run explicitly read jev-demos/lead_routing/lr11-s11/senselab/learned-mid-market-emea-5b6fddc3@v8 with value {"text": "Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded.", "action": "decide:partner", "worked": false, "situation": "mid_market/emea"} and still responded "decision: partner (confidence 0.97)", which the reviewer graded a miss: "review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded." The live entry now asserts "Partner closed the deal in 30 days." (worked: true), contradicting earlier evidence. Since conditions separating the two outcomes are unknown and other failing runs had no entry reads, the smallest safe change is a risk note to avoid relying on this lesson without corroboration and to lower confidence or seek human review until verified.
